in_marathi.name: Hemvati
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of wealth and prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hemvati हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Hemvati is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'hem' meaning wealth and 'vati' meaning she who holds or personification of wealth. This name is associated with the goddess Lakshmi, who is the deity of wealth, fortune, and prosperity in Hinduism. Hemvati is considered an auspicious name for girls, symbolizing wealth, abundance, and prosperity in their lives.
